items.title: Gus Fontenot Interview
items.q: with Vanna Band, Adam Broussard, Herbert McPoolton and I, we were the farmers there.

ctx.x: Mr. Fontenet, would you tell us something about your music training when you were a child, something about your music in your home and so on?

Well, music training when I was a child, in my home, I started learning music when I was 17 years old. And as I said, with Vanna Band, Adam Broussard, Herbert McPoolton and I, we were the farmers there. Vanna Band and then Tom Edwards, we got Tom Edwards.
